We didn’t just attend BRICS. We showed up to the conversation.

As a Gold Sponsor, LanceSoft was proud to be part of a gathering that brought together business leaders, industry voices, and innovators for conversations around the opportunities and challenges shaping today’s evolving business landscape.

The conference was more than a meeting of minds. It was an opportunity to exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, build meaningful connections, and explore what comes next.

From conversations at our booth to interactions across the conference floor, we came away with new perspectives, stronger connections, and plenty to take forward.

Because the most valuable part of any conference isn’t just being there, it’s being part of the conversation.

Here’s a look at some of our moments from BRICS Conference 2026.
